comments.author: claude
comments.content: VERIFIED — Copilot is WRONG here; do NOT apply the 27->26 change (it would introduce an error). Rigorous net-count of PR #1140's diff: 33 distinct set_preference names removed, 7 re-added (typo-fix browser.safebrowsing.phising->phishing + reorders), = 27 NET removed prefs. The body prose ('Remove 27 Firefox preferences') is CORRECT. The real discrepancy Copilot noticed is internal to the body: the prose says 27 but the category breakdown sums to 26 -> one removed pref is missing from a category. FIX = add the missing pref to its category so the breakdown sums to 27 (NOT change the prose to 26). Recommend: rebut the Copilot thread with the net-count evidence + fix the category breakdown. (Lesson: the naive grep of removed set_preference lines gives 33; net-of-readded gives 27; trusting Copilot's 26 was wrong.) Leaving the actual rebuttal/edit for Stefan — it's his ready PR + reverses earlier guidance.

comments.content:
Recount done reproducibly from `gh pr diff 1140` (set difference on distinct set_preference NAMES):
- 33 distinct names removed (- lines); 7 distinct names added (+ lines)
- 6 of the added are removed-then-re-added unchanged (comment-only churn): app.update.url, browser.search.update, extensions.blocklist.enabled, browser.safebrowsing.provider.{mozilla,google,google4}.lists
- 1 added is the corrected typo name browser.safebrowsing.phishing.enabled
- NET removed = 33 - 6 = 27. Prose count "27" is CORRECT; Copilot's "26" is WRONG. Confirms the recorded #67 verdict.

Body breakdown inconsistency confirmed and fixed: the category list enumerated only 26 of the 27 net-removed prefs. The exact missing pref was browser.safebrowsing.phising.enabled (the typo'd name, genuinely net-removed). Fixed by adding a new "Safebrowsing" category for it; breakdown now sums to 27. Prose "27" left unchanged.
